title: Day 11 CD alert; Yoshua picks 1; steps arrive on day 13
judgeNotes: Alert: $5,000 CD matures Fri Nov 20; option 1 pay off card ($2,214 or the right current number) + rest to savings; option 2 renew. After '1': 'Got it, I'll text you the steps Friday morning'. On day 13: concrete steps he does himself. PacePay never moves money.

title: Day 11 CD alert; Yoshua says 'just renew it'
CD alert; Yoshua asks 'which is better long term?' then picks

steps.say: which one is better long term? and is there a penalty?

judgeNotes: Answer the question with honest numbers (card APR 24.99% vs CD ~4.1%); it matures so there's no early-withdrawal penalty. Then the pick is understood.

title: CD alert; Yoshua: 'neither, ill figure it out'
judgeNotes: Respect it; short ack; no nagging.

title: Full demo deal, then skip to day 11: CD alert reflects the new state
judgeNotes: Skipping days fires the reminders/paycheck watch on the way (that's fine if accurate). CD alert numbers must match the card balance by then.

title: CD: Yoshua picks 1, then later texts '2' (change of mind)
judgeNotes: A change of mind before maturity should be honored or clearly addressed, not ignored or misread.
